extra.message: Insecure deserialization (pickle) in payroll_bundle_thaw_170 — Remote code execution on the server, leading to full compromise. [verified: The function payroll_bundle_thaw_170 directly passes user-controlled input (request.body or GET parameter 'blob', optionally base64-decoded) to pickle.loads, enabling arbitrary code execution. The _wrk_gate check only restricts access to authenticated users, not the deserialization itself.]

Code injection via eval in payroll_formula_cast_252 — Remote code execution on the server. [verified: The GET parameter 'expr' is passed directly to eval() with only __builtins__ restricted, which is insufficient to prevent RCE via Python object internals (e.g., ().__class__.__bases__[0].__subclasses__()). No input validation or sanitization exists; _wrk_gate only controls access, not the injection itself.]
